# Joe & Bella

> > Joe & Bella designs award-winning adaptive clothing featuring innovative magnetic buttons, CareZips technology, and accessible apparel for individuals with mobility challenges.

Joe & Bella specializes in adaptive fashion that combines functionality with style, offering HSA/FSA-eligible clothing including magnetic button shirts, CareZips pants, and accessibility-focused outerwear. Their product line emphasizes one-handed dressing capability and ease of use for people with limited mobility.

## Key Topics

- Adaptive Clothing
- CareZips®
- Magnetic Buttons
- HoodEase™
- Accessibility Fashion
- One-Handed Dressing
- HSA/FSA Eligible
- Magnetic Zipper
- Side-Zip Pants
- Mobility Assistance
- Relaxed-Fit Design
- Gripper Socks
- Compression Socks
- Adaptive Outerwear
- Button-Down Shirts

- [Short-Sleeve Everyday Magnetic-Button Shirt for Men](https://joeandbella.com/products/short-sleeve-everyday-magnetic-button-shirt-for-men): Short-sleeve magnetic button shirt for men with easy dressing and HSA/FSA eligibility.
- [Everyday Magnetic Flannel for Men](https://joeandbella.com/products/magnetic-flannel-for-men-relaxed-fit): Men's magnetic flannel shirt with relaxed-fit design for one-handed dressing capability.
